metadata.approved_architecture: Option B — Shared Accounting/POS Core + Independent Cafe Applications

cloud_backup_workstream.verification: All cloud backup changes committed in commit 0547aa3 prior to Phase 1 were left untouched and isolated from fix/dual-tenant-isolation.

files_modified.vulnerability_resolved: Lack of explicit tenant ownership on open table sessions
files_modified.summary: Added optional tenantId?: string property to TableSessionTab interface to partition session ownership.

files_modified.vulnerability_resolved: RSK-01 (Global storage key cafeos_raw_ingredients_v2 causing cross-cafe stock depletion)
files_modified.summary: Scoped keys by tenant ID, added independent seed catalogs for 100 HICH and Modendo, implemented multi-tenant in-memory cache, added tenantId parameterization, safe idempotent migration, and rollback function.

files_modified.vulnerability_resolved: RSK-02 (Global keys cafeos_table_tabs_v2, cafeos_reserved_tables_v1, and line 339 hardcoded tenant-100hich-01 dispatch)
files_modified.summary: Scoped table tab and reservation keys, replaced line 339 hardcoded tenant with dynamic validated tenant identity, enforced cross-tenant rejection, and scoped inventory deductions.

files_modified.vulnerability_resolved: RSK-03 (Global BroadcastChannel cafeos_barista_channel broadcasting order tickets across all open cafe tabs)
files_modified.summary: Scoped BroadcastChannel and persisted tickets by tenant ID, added security gate rejecting cross-tenant tickets, validated tenant context on dispatch, and scoped listener subscriptions.

files_modified.vulnerability_resolved: RSK-07 / RSK-10 (Single database CafeOS_LocalDB collision hazard on un-prefixed primary keys)
files_modified.summary: Implemented independent databases per tenant (CafeOS_LocalDB_${tenantId}), added dynamic Proxy wrapper for backward-compatible db export, preserved schema versions 1-3, and added non-destructive migration.

files_modified.vulnerability_resolved: Offline queue database cross-tenant collision risk
files_modified.summary: Scoped offline queue database to CafeOS_OfflineDB_${tenantId} and added getOfflineSyncQueueForTenant factory.
Added test:phase1 script and linked it into npm test.

new_test_suites.coverage: Independent inventory initialization, stock deductions, adjustments, simultaneous orders, legacy migration, idempotency, rollback, missing and unknown tenant isolation.
Independent table sessions, table reservations, concurrent tabs, session restoration, barista dispatch ownership, cross-tenant rejection, and legacy migration.
100 HICH delivery, Modendo delivery, cross-tenant event rejection on BroadcastChannel, multi-tab communication, status change lifecycle, and channel reconnection.
Independent database initialization, table coverage across 10 tables, primary key collision proof, proxy delegation, offline queue scoping, and legacy migration.

documentation_files.summary: Detailed change log of all file diffs, architecture decisions, and scope boundaries.
Complete test execution breakdown of all 13 test suites (713 passed, 0 failed), lint and build evidence.
Deep architectural guide and data flow diagrams for Option B isolation remediation.
Operational legacy data migration, idempotency verification, and automated rollback instructions.
Catalog of non-isolation risks (VAT contradiction, brand themes, storage god-file) and Phase 2 roadmap.

files_not_modified: src/components/ReceiptPreview.tsx & LiveReceiptPreview.tsx (Strict receipt and VAT freeze)
server.ts & cloud backup workstream in original repository branch
All CSS stylesheets and design token files

RSK-01.solution: Scoped storage keys by tenant ID (cafeos_raw_ingredients_${tenantId}_v2), partitioned in-memory cache, independent seed stores, and tenant context parameterization.

RSK-02.solution: Scoped table session and reservation keys (cafeos_table_tabs_${tenantId}_v2), removed line 339 hardcoded tenant-100hich-01 dispatch, and enforced cross-tenant rejection.

RSK-03.solution: Scoped BroadcastChannel by tenant ID (cafeos_barista_channel_${tenantId}), scoped ticket storage, security gate dropping foreign tenant tickets, and tenant-scoped subscriptions.

RSK-07_RSK-10.solution: Independent databases per tenant (CafeOS_LocalDB_${tenantId} and CafeOS_OfflineDB_${tenantId}), dynamic Proxy db wrapper for backward compatibility, and non-destructive legacy migration.

migration_strategy.idempotency: Every migration checks if the scoped target store is already initialized; if populated, migration safely skips with 0 overwrites.
migration_strategy.unit_and_quantity_preservation: All 3-decimal float quantities, costs per unit, safety thresholds, and timestamps are preserved verbatim.
migration_strategy.rollback_capability: Rollback functions (rollbackLegacyMigration()) restore legacy keys from backup and purge scoped stores on demand.
